# Cozy Town derived actions (stand/sit/read/rest)

- Original author: Spaceyyy; license CC-BY 4.0; credit "Cozy Town Lite" by Spaceyyy — https://aquumgifts.itch.io
- This is a **project-derived** sheet, not an original third-party action pack.
- Modifications: extracted 4 idle frames (down/left/right/up); removed lower legs and drew folded seated legs in the same palette; added a small open book for `read`; closed eyes and Z pixels for `rest`. `stand` is unmodified idle.
